summary:
Held 2 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — RNO.PA +5%, JD.L +4%, FME.DE +4%, PAH3.DE +4%, RKT.L +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 2 downside moves (BESI.AS -10%, GLE.PA -5%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: BESI.AS (-9.97%) — No confirmed Oct 8 news found. Likely another leg of the 2026 hybrid-bonding doubt (HBM timing, ASML entry, SK hynix comments), with the stock already down about 40-46% from its June high. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: BESI.AS is a mid/large-cap Dutch semiconductor-equipment name listed on Euronext Amsterdam, and no strategy covers it. The bot also can't short, and a -10% day is a downside move it wouldn't have bought.

top_movers.suggestion: Add CAC 40 / Stoxx 600 autos constituents (RNO.PA, STLAM.MI, VOW3.DE) to the momentum universe, and add a sector-basket trigger that admits peers when 2+ names in a sector gap up ≥3% on shared news.
